rubric.description: Correctly implements the base case (n == 0, returning 1)
Correctly implements the recursive case (n * factorial(n - 1))
Returns the correct value for the given base and recursive cases
Declares a base case for when s has length 0 or 1, returning it directly
Correctly makes the recursive call on the substring excluding the first character (e.g. s.substring(1))
Correctly appends the first character (s.charAt(0)) after the recursive result
Declares the base case (low > high), returning -1
Correctly handles the case where arr[mid] equals target, returning mid
Correctly recurses on the appropriate half depending on whether arr[mid] is less than or greater than target
